formal_statement: ∃ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (_ : DecidableRel G.Adj) (t : ℕ), (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ¬ (G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj b c ∧ G.Adj c d ∧ G.Adj d a)) ∧ (∃ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ T ∨ v ∈ T) ∧ T.card = t) ∧ (∀ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → u ∈ T ∨ v ∈ T) → t ≤ T.card) ∧ t ≤ 5 ∧ ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin gates.length), ∀ w ∈ (gates.get i).inputs, w < n + (i : ℕ)) ∧ (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) ∧ ∃ I : Finset (Fin gates.length), (∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → i ∈ I) ∧ I.card < t
plain_statement: There are a finite simple graph G with no cycle of length 4 whose least vertex cover has t vertices, t at most 5, and a circuit whose gates are AND or OR gates each reading exactly two earlier wires, one input per vertex, whose output is true exactly on the inputs containing both ends of some edge of G, with fewer than t AND gates.
title: Some graph with no 4-cycle and cover number t at most 5 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for its edge function, earlier wires only, with fewer than t AND gates
